employees.label: Employees
employees.definition: Employees located in the U.S., 10-K Human Capital (approximate).

source.label: FY2025 Form 10-K, Item 1, Human Capital
source.quote: Our global employees work predominantly full-time and represent 142 nationalities, across 28 countries, including approximately 9,600 located in the U.S.

source.label: FY2025 Form 10-K, Item 1, Human Capital
source.quote: As of December 31, 2025, we employed approximately 23,800 people globally, with 46% in the Americas, 42% in Asia-Pacific, and 12% in Europe and the Middle East.

sites.name: Corporate headquarters
sites.description: Our corporate headquarters are located in San Jose, California and occupy approximately 0.7 million of owned square feet.

source.label: FY2025 Form 10-K, Item 2, Properties
source.quote: Our corporate headquarters are located in San Jose, California and occupy approximately 0.7 million of owned square feet.

notes: PayPal's FY2025 10-K gives regional employee shares (Americas 46%, Asia-Pacific 42%, Europe and the Middle East 12% of ~23,800) and a U.S. headcount of ~9,600, as of Dec 31, 2025; no country lists define the regions, and the Americas share includes the U.S. Item 2 gives only aggregate square footage (2.0 million sq ft in the U.S., 1.7 million in other countries) and the San Jose HQ; no other sites, state data or country-level tax data were found in the 10-K. Period: Dec 31, 2025.
